name: py_stats_median
issue: median() returns the wrong value for lists with an even number of items. For example median([4, 1, 3, 2]) returns 3, but the median should be 2.5, the average of the two middle values.

name: cpp_strutil_trim
issue: strutil::trim cuts off the last character of the text. trim("  hello  ") returns "hell" instead of "hello", and trim("x") returns an empty string.

name: rs_wordcount_spaces
issue: word_count gives wrong results when words are separated by more than one space, or by tabs or newlines. word_count("the  quick   brown fox") returns 7 instead of 4, and word_count("") returns 1 instead of 0.
